mapper.sql: action_id, user_id, agent_run_id, conversation_id, action_type, required_permission, status, payload_json, payload_hash, result_json, summary, page_context, request_id, expires_at, confirmed_at, executed_at, error_message, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_pending_action WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND action_id=#{actionId}
SELECT FROM ai_pending_action WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='PENDING_CONFIRMATION' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_pending_action (action_id, user_id, agent_run_id, action_type, required_permission, payload_json, payload_hash, summary, page_context, request_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{actionId}, #{userId}, #{agentRunId}, #{actionType}, #{requiredPermission}, #{payloadJson}, #{payloadHash}, #{summary}, #{pageContext}, #{requestId}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_pending_action SET status='EXECUTING', confirmed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND action_id=#{actionId} AND status='PENDING_CONFIRMATION' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE ai_pending_action SET status='EXECUTED', result_json=#{resultJson}, executed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_message=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND action_id=#{actionId} AND status='EXECUTING'
UPDATE ai_pending_action SET status='FAILED', error_message=#{errorMessage} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND action_id=#{actionId} AND status='EXECUTING'
UPDATE ai_pending_action SET status='EXPIRED', error_message='确认操作已过期' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND action_id=#{actionId} AND status='PENDING_CONFIRMATION'
UPDATE ai_pending_action SET status='CANCELLED', error_message='用户取消待确认操作' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND action_id=#{actionId} AND status='PENDING_CONFIRMATION'
UPDATE ai_pending_action SET status='CANCELLED', error_message=#{errorMessage} WHERE agent_run_id=#{agentRunId} AND status='PENDING_CONFIRMATION'
